The explicit 7-edge theta coefficient vector has every edge nonzero except at half flux. Bipartite gauge maps the \(\pm t\) eigensectors. Independent actual \(5\times4\) Hamiltonian checks give ten residuals <1e-12, while exhaustive small-window support checks corroborate the graph classification; the proof, not enumeration, establishes the infinite statement.

value.rationale: The minimum physical number of excited waveguides is a natural experimentally relevant invariant for the source’s oscillating flat-band confinement. A flux arbitrarily close to zero changes its sharp optimum from 8 to 14 while half flux admits a distinct 12-site cage; all three regimes admit matched \(\pm t\) supports for periodic confined beating. These are nontrivial boundaries on resources/geometry and not an arbitrary lattice-size slice. The connection to classical gain circuits is explicitly disclosed; no generic theorem is asserted as new.
